name: chess350
description: 350 Chess — web chess with online (invite code) and local play. CS350 team project.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @chess350/server" "npm run dev -w @chess350/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chess350/client && npm run build -w @chess350/server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
